annual.label: Typical yearly maintenance after free scheduled service ends, about $250–$500 (Recharged, 10,000–12,000 mi/yr, not counting tires)

maint.every: Often 60,000–80,000 miles with heavy use of regenerative braking; inspect every 12 months
maint.note: Recharged estimates about $700–$900 per axle at an independent shop and $900–$1,300 at a dealer for pads and new rotors.
Rear pads cost about the same as the front. Light use can let rotors rust, which is a common reason to replace them early.

maint.every: About every 4–6 years, or sooner if it keeps going flat
maint.note: This is the small 12-volt battery, not the high-voltage drive battery. Repeated dead batteries point to an ICCU or software problem, not just the battery.

maint.every: Inspect every 3–4 years or 30,000–40,000 miles; replace when the Genesis schedule calls for it
maint.note: Coolant changes on this EV are measured in years, not miles. Brake fluid (about $150–$300) is due about every 3–4 years.
